pieces.name: My piano sketch, arranged for strings
pieces.words: I compare two ways to arrange my theme for strings, then finish A. This is a recorded walkthrough and uses no credit.
guide: This is a recorded walkthrough and uses no credit.
In Study, confirm both Piano upper and Piano lower as Piano.
Skip all three questions. Leave the optional direction blank.
In Setup, use Arrange and String orchestra. Keep all source notes, stay neutral and add no bars.
Choose Create. Compare A, Held middle voices with repeat contrast, and B, Pulsed support with brief answers. Both have a recorded preview of bars 1 to 8.
Choose A and write the rest. A is complete across bars 1 to 24. B has only its first-section preview.
Export A directly while it is selected. Download MIDI includes the notation and separate part files. Other answers, settings or rewrites have no prepared reply.
